get.summary: Summarize registered Ticket and Task time by technician alias
get.description: Requires report.view, ticket.view, task.view and a read-only Sanctum bearer token bound to an active approved coordinator workload with worklog.read in both token and workload. No wildcard/write scopes. Installation, provider/model, workload, expiry, network and rate gates apply; response profile is always pseudonymized. maximum_results caps the whole date window, not each page. meta.total is uncapped; meta.truncated=true requires disjoint period subdivision. A single truncated day requires policy review; never claim a complete export. No snapshot isolation. Installation context_scope and workload allowlist intersection apply; see Report Knowledge contract.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive work date; defaults to six days before the resolved date_to. Send YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Inclusive work date; defaults to today in the installation timezone. Range must fit maximum_query_days.

200.description: Successful bounded read; check meta.truncated even when next_page is null.

401.description: Missing or invalid Sanctum authentication; JSON message.

403.description: Coordinator policy denial with reason_code/request_id, or missing report.view with JSON message.

422.description: Invalid date/page input or range/page size above policy; JSON message and errors keyed by field.

429.description: Workload/binding rate exceeded; reason_code=request_rate_exceeded and request_id. Wait for the 60-second limiter window before retrying.

get.summary: Read registered Ticket and Task time within a bounded date window
get.description: Requires report.view, ticket.view, task.view and a read-only Sanctum bearer token bound to an active approved coordinator workload with time-entries.read in both token and workload. No wildcard/write scopes. Installation, provider/model, workload, expiry, network and rate gates apply; response profile is always pseudonymized. maximum_results caps the whole date window, not each page. meta.total is uncapped; meta.truncated=true requires disjoint period subdivision. A single truncated day requires policy review; never claim a complete export. No snapshot isolation. Installation context_scope and workload allowlist intersection apply; see Report Knowledge contract.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive work date; defaults to six days before the resolved date_to. Send YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Inclusive work date; defaults to today in the installation timezone. Range must fit maximum_query_days.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page within available_total, never beyond the policy ceiling. Follow meta.next_page.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Default min(25, maximum_page_size); larger than the policy maximum returns 422.

200.description: Successful bounded read; check meta.truncated even when next_page is null.

post.summary: Preview internal Task creation from saved activity
post.description: Default-off, active employee only. Requires workday.manage_own and Task view/create/update permissions plus all listed token scopes. Saved owner/version checked server-side. Explicit preview and create command only. Existing Task or Ticket time is linked through Sources and allocations. Creation uses standalone internal non-billable Task actions; no Ticket billing, automatic completion or day confirmation. Unpaid breaks are excluded; existing numeric attribution cannot overlap. Creation receipt is historical; GET the Task and Workday for current state. Confirmed days preserve prior confirmation and receive a correction draft. Preview expires after 30 minutes; retained evidence expires with the workday. Retries with identical Idempotency-Key return the stored response; stale/consumed preview with a new key fails without duplicate writes.

put.summary: Save effective own time without separate confirmation
put.description: Requires workdays.write plus its explicit Workday permission. Active human employee identity is resolved from authentication; foreign owners and coordinator workload tokens are denied. Workday is default-off. Save is effective immediately, never payroll approval or billing. A mapped clock duration rounds once to hundredths of an hour; an incompatible clock placement becomes duration-only. Existing private drafts are not exported until explicitly saved. Mutations are versioned and retry-safe. Read data.id and data.version from the persisted response; list/history are paginated.

request_id.description: Idempotent create UUID. Same UUID with different content returns 409.

starts_at.description: Local clock YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm. Gaps and folds are rejected.

ends_at.description: Local clock; after start, at most 24 hours.

recurrence_ends_at.description: Required for weekly series; at most one year.

occurrence_starts_at.description: Required for one occurrence in a series. Use its original instant including numeric offset.

link_status.description: Only explicitly allowed facts and opaque joins are documented for coordinator disclosure.

approval_status.description: Current contract state, not historical approval or a customer document.

minutes.description: Direct registered consumption, separate from Ticket/Task actual minutes.

entry_alias.description: Same alias as Report for direct Ticket rows; Task billing projection has no actual-time entry match.

record_alias.description: Ticket alias for direct entries; Task alias for consistent authorized Task billing groups. Do not allocate rounded deltas to individual Task entries.

basis_minutes.description: Billing basis; do not add to actual work or direct consumption totals.

entry_alias.description: Workload- and source-scoped stable alias; deduplication key within this workload and installation key.

client_alias.description: Opaque alias, not a Commercial client_id. No identity lookup is provided.

registration_basis.description: Estimated Task completion time is explicitly labelled; recorded does not certify measured or payroll-approved time.

minutes.description: Stored time, not a rounded billing projection or approved payroll time.

billable.description: Stored source flag; not proof of invoicing, timebank consumption or chargeable amount.

active_days.description: Distinct work dates for this technician. Do not sum overlapping periods.

total.description: All matching entries (time-entries) or non-null technicians (technicians), before result capping.

available_total.description: min(total, maximum_results); ceiling for this date window across all pages.

truncated.description: True if policy hides matching rows. An empty next page does not make the window complete.

last_page.description: Pages of available_total, with minimum 1 even for an empty window.

next_page.description: Next page within the capped window, otherwise null. Still inspect truncated.

reason_code.description: Present for coordinator middleware denials; exact codes are listed in the Knowledge contract.

request_id.description: Metadata-only audit correlation identifier for middleware denials.

enabled.description: Employee planning contract. Every route remains behind the Workday runtime switch.

end.description: Earlier than start means the following day; equal times are invalid.

revision.description: Opaque revision from the latest GET. Stale writes return 409.

accept_calendar_conflicts.description: Required true when the preview contains unowned Calendar rules. Those rules remain in force.

version.description: 0 at creation; otherwise latest version from readback.

start_date.description: Required for full_day, prohibited for partial. First calendar day in record timezone.

end_date.description: Required for full_day, prohibited for partial. Last day included.

starts_at.description: Required for partial, prohibited for full_day. Minute-precise local ISO time or offset/Z. Ambiguous local time needs an offset.

ends_at.description: Required for partial, prohibited for full_day. End excluded; at most 366 elapsed days.

expires_at.description: Fixed original three-year retention deadline, also for revisions and receipts.

plan_impact.description: Present on show/mutations, computed from current effective-dated plan. Historical revisions preserve source facts, not dynamic plan calculations.

unknown_dates.description: No standard hours assumed; planned_minutes may be incomplete.

has_work_conflicts.description: Present on show/mutations. Actual work is not adjusted.

work_conflicts.description: Present on show/mutations; details additionally require workday.view_own.

kind.description: Deliberately separate from owner responses: no current revision, absence or private correction metadata.

status.description: List omits source reads. Detail/history recheck viewer source grants and token scopes.
Complete only if this first page contains the full result. No silent result ceiling.

totals.description: Full filtered confirmed set, including rows not on this page. Refresh between requests; pagination is not an immutable export.

eligible.description: Counts may overlap: one expired reminder can also have an expired notification copy.

diagnostic_copies.description: Workday diagnostic entries and their request batch siblings have no retention purpose.

untracked_notification_copies.description: Legacy copies lacking provenance block restore readiness until their source is reconciled or expired and purged.

restore_ready.description: Application inventory only. Does not certify external backups, diagnostic archives or worker readiness.

source_key.description: Stable identity returned by source discovery.

source_revision.description: Exact source content fingerprint. Changes require a new explicit selection.

calendar_id.description: Required for Calendar evidence; null for Task/Ticket.

start.description: Optional employee placement, with end. Same local/offset and DST rules as actual intervals.

acknowledged.description: Must be true for planned, estimated or unknown evidence. Does not change its original basis.

source_key.description: Stable identity returned by source discovery.

source_revision.description: Exact source content fingerprint. Changes require a new explicit selection.

calendar_id.description: Required for Calendar evidence; null for Task/Ticket.

start.description: Optional employee placement, with end. Same local/offset and DST rules as actual intervals.

acknowledged.description: Must be true for planned, estimated or unknown evidence. Does not change its original basis.

allocations.description: Complete replacement. Empty array clears. Split by repeating a source with non-overlapping placements; all allocations together remain within actual minutes and remaining source capacity.

title.description: Read live under source permissions; not copied into Workday history.

total.description: Unknown when unavailable; Calendar total is the observed count and may be a lower bound when truncated.

calendars.description: Present when choosing a Calendar. At most 100 permitted calendars.

version.description: Explicit creation is separate from Workday confirmation and from billable Ticket time.

start.description: Optional selected start inside the interval. Same local/offset and DST rules as Workday. Defaults to the saved start.

end.description: Optional selected end inside the interval. Defaults to the saved end.

description.description: Exact Task description and time note. No hidden source description is copied.

reason.description: Required when the current revision is confirmed.

create_task.description: Explicit employee instruction to create the reviewed Task and time. Does not confirm the day.

ranges.description: Exact work placements after excluded breaks; one Task time entry holds their summed minutes.

state.description: Present on GET read-back. Ready means the saved version and expiry match; source and target access are rechecked on create.

preview.description: Present on preview and GET read-back.

conversion.description: Present on creation and GET read-back. Retained creation receipt; current Task is read via the existing Task API.

start.description: ISO timestamp with explicit offset or Z; whole minutes.

end.description: Exclusive end, ISO timestamp with explicit offset or Z.

timezone.description: Saved day timezone, or the employee work-plan timezone before first save.

version.description: 0 before first save; otherwise the saved day version for optimistic writes.

day.description: Persisted own day, or null. Opening an unregistered date creates nothing.

can_edit.description: True only for an unconfirmed date with current manage permission and workdays.write token ability; save rechecks all constraints.

requires_correction.description: Confirmed days require the existing correction operation before editing.

planned_minutes.description: Effective plan after dated availability and explicit absence. Never actual or confirmed minutes.

planned_intervals.description: Effective planned ranges in UTC, after explicit absence.

available_intervals.description: Planned ranges minus current saved work and adjacent retained reservations. Not permission to save or an exhaustive list of allowed work times.

suggested_interval.description: First available period up to 60 minutes, in record-local time with offset. Null when not editable, fully recorded, no effective plan, or the interval limit is reached. Saving still requires explicit actual time.

reserved_intervals.description: Merged own current/confirmed intervals from retained neighboring work dates within four dates either side. UTC boundaries only, no descriptions or foreign work.

start.description: Minute-precise local ISO date/time or RFC3339 with offset/Z. Ambiguous local times need an explicit offset.

included.description: True counts the break as actual work; false subtracts its actual elapsed minutes.

version.description: 0 for first creation, otherwise the latest day version. Stale versions return 409.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, immutable after first creation.

allocations.description: Optional complete replacement; omit to preserve current selections, send [] to clear. All preserved selections are revalidated.

hours.description: Hundredths of an hour. Zero removes this activity/project row.

intervals.description: Clock mode: supply intervals and breaks. Empty intervals explicitly remove all time.

durations.description: Duration mode: replaces the whole date. Requires an explicit employee mapping. Do not combine with clock intervals.

preview_token.description: Unexpired token from preview for this exact owner, day and revision.

confirmed.description: Explicit employee confirmation. Never infer confirmation from activity or draft save.

accept_absence_conflicts.description: Required when preview data.absence_warnings is nonempty. Review work and absence before acknowledging. An intervening absence change invalidates the preview.

units.description: Hundredths of an hour; multiply by 36 for seconds.

absence_overlap_acknowledged.description: Present on confirmed snapshots; true if overlapping absence was explicitly acknowledged.

absence_warnings.description: Generic overlap warnings, without absence reasons.

preview.description: Present only for preview operations; validity is at most 30 minutes.
